verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's own job model chains multiple tasks in one request (import, convert, export), and it has native multi-file tasks: merging many files into one PDF and creating archives from many files. That is some first-party many-items-at-once capability. However, no documented batch or bulk conversion endpoint is shown for processing many independent items in a single operation, and the job example covers only one file's pipeline. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch API for many independent files, documented limits on batch size, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk usage.
